# 96. Andreas Almgrens finanskarriär

**Feed**: veckans-trade  
**Published**: 2026-11-04  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

This is the Veckans Trade episode about Andreas Almgren winning the New York Marathon. The host spends most of it attacking Valuno Group after former CEO Daniel Sonesson was charged with aggravated insider trading, and mocking small-cap biotechs (Cereno Scientific, Orexo, BioInvent, Dicot) over share collapses and unpriced share issues. The rest covers Q3 reports (RaySearch, Invisio), a Pareto analyst's bullish case for Camurus, the host's bullish view on rate-sensitive real estate stocks, a Protean-inspired short AAK/Cloetta and long BioGaia idea, and a sharp US tech/AI sell-off (Alphabet, Amazon, Intel, Lumentum) ahead of an Anthropic IPO.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 CAMX — Camurus | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 75%

Pareto healthcare analyst Filip Wiberg calls Camurus a top pick with good risk-reward ahead of the CAM2029 GEP-NET readout.

#### Reasoning

Cited analyst view (Pareto): about 3bn SEK sales at 40% EBIT margin limits the downside. The CAM2029 GEP-NET superiority study, due Q4/Q1, has peak sales potential up to 10x today's. Many like the stock but avoid binary risk, so a positive readout could bring strong buying. The analyst reads the delay as likely a good sign.

#### Sell Triggers

- negative GEP-NET superiority readout
- further readout delays
- erosion of the base business margin

> *"Ja, vi är positiva till Camurus. Det är ett av våra topics inom hälsosektorn."*

---

### 🟢 CAST — Castellum | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 55%

Host sees real estate stocks as an open goal, especially if peace lowers oil and the 10-year yield.

#### Reasoning

Host view: real estate stocks have no flesh-and-blood owners and move on algo flows tied to oil and rates. Lower oil means lower inflation, lower 10-year yields and cheaper refinancing. The host calls it a good buying point and an open goal now, even more so if there is Middle East peace.

#### Sell Triggers

- 10-year yield rises
- oil spikes on escalating war
- inflation re-accelerates

> *"Jag tycker det är öppet mål för fastighetsaktier nu med."*

---

### 🟢 BALD-B — Balder | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 55%

Part of the host's bullish real estate view on falling rates.

#### Reasoning

Same thesis as Castellum: real estate stocks trade on oil and yield moves, and lower yields enable refinancing. Host calls it a good buying point.

#### Sell Triggers

- 10-year yield rises
- oil spikes

> *"Det här är ett bra köpläge."*

---

### ⛔ IVSO — Invisio | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Fell 15% on report; host says it has always been very expensive and that MilDef is better and cheaper.

#### Reasoning

Host view: Invisio is 'svindyrt' and has always been expensive. MilDef is cheaper on every multiple, so the host prefers MilDef within defence.

#### Sell Triggers

- valuation compresses to peer levels
- strong order intake re-rates growth

> *"Men det här bolaget tycker jag är svindyrt. Mildef gör allting mycket bättre."*

---

### 🟠 MILDEF — MilDef | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Host prefers MilDef over Invisio as cheaper on all multiples.

#### Reasoning

Relative-value comment from the host: MilDef is cheaper than Invisio on every multiple and 'does everything better'. The host admits they are quite different companies.

#### Sell Triggers

- defence spending outlook weakens
- valuation premium closes

> *"Mildef gör allting mycket bättre. Det är billigare på alla multiplar sätt."*

---

### 🔴 AAK — AAK | **SELL** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Cited Protean (Pontus Nackmo) short on the GLP-1 thesis of lower fat consumption; host floats a poor man's version but won't do it.

#### Reasoning

Cited fund view: GLP-1/Ozempic use cuts calorie-dense fat intake, hurting AAK's specialty fats. The host proposes short AAK/Cloetta, long BioGaia as a poor man's Protean trade but says he will not do it himself.

#### Sell Triggers

- volumes hold up despite GLP-1 adoption
- Protean closes its short

> *"Proteiner är korta AK på grund av att de ser att den här obesitas-trenden gör att folk äter mer proteindens food"*

---

### 🔴 CLA-B — Cloetta | **SELL** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Host suggests shorting Cloetta as a more concentrated GLP-1 loser.

#### Reasoning

Host view: Cloetta is concentrated in sweets, so earnings risk a collapse if GLP-1 drugs cut candy consumption. Speculative, and the host says he won't execute it.

#### Sell Triggers

- strong report showing no volume decline
- GLP-1 adoption stalls

> *"Men man kan korta istället. Cloetta, tänker jag."*

---

### 🟢 BIOG-B — BioGaia | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Host's proposed long leg as a concentrated probiotics play mirroring Protean.

#### Reasoning

Host view: BioGaia is a concentrated probiotics play that benefits if diets shift towards protein and probiotic foods under GLP-1. Speculative pair idea that the host won't trade.

#### Sell Triggers

- probiotics demand fails to benefit from GLP-1 diets

> *"Och så kan man långa Biogaia som är mycket mer koncentrerat."*

---

### 🟢 ANOD-B — Addnode | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Prio Nilsson fund manager Martin Lindqvist increased Addnode on a too-low valuation and Q3 operational improvement.

#### Reasoning

Guest (sponsor fund manager) view: the SaaS sell-off pushed Addnode's valuation too low, and Q3 shows signs of operating improvement. The holding has contributed well since the summer.

#### Sell Triggers

- operational improvement reverses
- AI disruption hits the software model

> *"Där tyckte vi helt enkelt att värderingen blev för låg här under den här SaaS-pocalypseen"*

---

### 🟢 ACAD — AcadeMedia | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Fund manager increased: political risk overdone, few Swedish owners, single-digit earnings multiples, European M&A.

#### Reasoning

Guest view: the market overprices political risk around Swedish independent schools. Positioning is light, the valuation is a single-digit P/E, and European acquisitions will reduce political risk over time.

#### Sell Triggers

- adverse Swedish school policy
- European M&A falters

> *"Där var väl synen att den politiska politiska risken var överdriven"*

---

### ⛔ CRNO-B — Cereno Scientific | **AVOID** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 80%

Down 44% in five days and now trading-halted; host suspects leaked bad news and says no bid is coming.

#### Reasoning

Host view: a halt after a 50% drop is not for a bid. A likely leak ahead of the report means it 'stinks', and long-term guests have warned about it for a long time.

#### Sell Triggers

- credible positive news when trading resumes

> *"Det stinker minst sagt kring Serena och Scientific."*

---

### ⛔ ORX — Orexo | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Became a pure biotech after divesting its cash-flow product; unpriced share issue at a discount; stock down 60%.

#### Reasoning

Host view: management gave a heavy failing grade for selling the quality business and launching an unpriced issue. Market cap is under 100 MSEK and the issue outcome is uncertain. The host himself bought the dip.

#### Sell Triggers

- successful issue and pipeline progress

> *"Så gravt underbetyg till management i både Orexo och Bioinvents styrelse."*

---

### ⛔ BINV — BioInvent | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Large unpriced rights issue sent the stock down 70%.

#### Reasoning

Host view: an unpriced rights issue is a sign of poor governance, and the price will likely come only in a few weeks, with dilution ahead.

#### Sell Triggers

- rights issue priced favourably and fully subscribed

> *"Man annonserade en jättefet företrädesemission utan pris. Axien går ner 70%"*
